# Equal Before the Law

<!-- STEP id="equality-before-law" -->
## Equality Before the Law

At a traffic stop, a big car and an auto-rickshaw follow the same signal and pay the same fine. This is **equality before the law**: "Every individual irrespective of status, identity, or rank is treated equally by the law."

<!-- STEP id="equal-protection" -->
## Equal Protection of the Law

Two neighbours break the same building rule, so both get the same notice. This is **equal protection of the law**: "All persons in similar circumstances shall be treated equally by law without arbitrary discrimination." Arbitrary means without a fair reason.

<!-- STEP id="article-21" -->
## Article 21

Article 21 of the Constitution states: "no persons shall be deprived of life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law."

**Even the State must follow a valid law, step by step, before it can take away your life or liberty.**
